# Orchard

> Orchard is a field-service scheduler for small teams.

## Docs

- [Work orders](/docs/work-orders.html): A work order is one visit to one site, with the parts and the technician assigned to it.
- [Dispatch board](/docs/dispatch.html): The dispatch board shows every unassigned work order for the day.
- [How to schedule a visit](/docs/schedule.html): Assign a technician and a time window to an open work order.
- **SLA** — the response time promised to a customer for a given severity.
- **orchard.api** — the REST interface, documented under API access.
